notesStmt.note: Whitman planned to write an essay about Elias Hicks for many years. While finishing preparations for the printing of November Boughs, Whitman told Horace Traubel, "Some of these bits were written as many as thirty years ago. Some of them I have written within the past year. They are a miscellaneous lot but they all belong in the same stream" (see Traubel, With Walt Whitman in Camden, 2:42). It is therefore difficult to determine the exact date of the present manuscript, although the paper and handwriting suggest a date in the 1870s.

A heavily revised prose draft fragment, portions of which appeared in the last paragraph of "Notes (such as they are) founded on Elias Hicks," first published in November Boughs (1888) before being collected under the same title in Complete Prose (1892).
